mapper.select:
select * from (select distinct uav.device_code, (case when length(IFNULL(rel.device_name, '')) = 0 then uav.device_name else rel.device_name end ) device_name, uav.device_status, ( SELECT DICT_LABEL FROM sys_dict_data WHERE DICT_TYPE = 'uav_device_status' AND DICT_VALUE = uav.device_status LIMIT 1 ) deviceStatusName, uav.manufacturer_code, uav.model_code, uav.location, uav.site_code, uav.province_code, uav.city_code, uav.county_code, uav.town_code, uav.device_type, uav.longitude, uav.latitude, uav.hanging_height as height, uav.camera_model_code cameraModelCode, uav.uav_nest_code uavNestCode, uav.access_node, pro.area_name as provinceName, city.area_name as cityName, county.area_name as countyName, town.area_name as townName,
CAST(ST_DISTANCE(POINT(#{param.userLongitude},#{param.userLatitude}),POINT(uav.longitude,uav.latitude))*111195 as DECIMAL(65,2)) as distance,
case when IFNULL(dct.user_device_coll_id,0) = 0 then '0' else '1' end isMonitor, (select DICT_LABEL FROM sys_dict_data where DICT_TYPE = 'uav_manufacturer' AND DICT_VALUE = uav.manufacturer_code limit 1) manufacturerName, model.model_name modelName, (select DICT_LABEL FROM sys_dict_data where DICT_TYPE = 'uav_device_type' and status = '0' AND DICT_VALUE = uav.device_type limit 1) deviceTypeName, (CASE WHEN od.ord_status in ('0','1','2') THEN '0' WHEN od.ord_status = '3' THEN '2' WHEN od.ord_status = '4' THEN '1' END) orderStatus, (CASE WHEN od.ord_status in ('0','1','2') THEN '有效' WHEN od.ord_status = '3' THEN '退订' WHEN od.ord_status = '4' THEN '失效' END) orderStatusName from vm_uav_device_info_t uav INNER JOIN vm_order_uav_devices od ON od.device_code = uav.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_device_common_rel_t rel ON rel.device_code = uav.device_code and rel.tenant_id = od.tenant_id and rel.industry_code = od.industry_code and rel.delete_flag = '0' and rel.device_type = 1 LEFT JOIN sys_area pro ON pro.area_code = uav.province_code LEFT JOIN sys_area city ON city.area_code = uav.city_code LEFT JOIN sys_area county ON county.area_code = uav.county_code LEFT JOIN sys_area town ON town.area_code = uav.town_code LEFT JOIN vm_uav_device_model_t model ON uav.model_code = model.model_code and model.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN vm_user_device_collection_t dct ON dct.coll_obj_code = uav.device_code AND dct.coll_obj_type = '11' AND dct.user_id = #{param.userId}
LEFT JOIN vm_organ_device_rel_t vod on vod.device_code = uav.device_code and vod.delete_flag = '0' and vod.tenant_id = od.tenant_id and vod.device_type = 11
where
${param.dataScope} GROUP BY od.tenant_id, od.industry_code, od.device_code
order by distance,uav.device_status,cast(uav.device_code as UNSIGNED),uav.device_code
order by uav.device_status,cast(uav.device_code as UNSIGNED),uav.device_code
order by uav.province_code, uav.city_code, uav.county_code,uav.device_code
) uav_data
uav_data.device_name like CONCAT('%', #{param.deviceName}, '%')
and ((uav_data.device_code like CONCAT('%', #{param.codeOrName}, '%')) or (uav_data.device_name like CONCAT('%', #{param.codeOrName}, '%')))
